serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: YARDOS US Government (YARDOS:USG) is a single, provider-operated, browser-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) and cost-estimating platform hosted exclusively in AWS GovCloud (US) for direct adoption by U.S. federal agencies (44 U.S.C. § 3506). Built for capital-intensive, long-service federal assets—including naval vessels, federal fleets, aerospace and defense depots, installations, and civil infrastructure—YARDOS:USG unifies work planning, inspection plans, condition found reports, change-order workflows, execution reporting, Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE) / growth-work IGE preparation (FAR 15.404-1, FAR 36.203, DFARS 243.204-70, GAO-20-195G), and agency-controlled specialist AI assistance in one cloud record. Each federal agency runs in a dedicated AWS GovCloud (US) account with agency identity federation, governed in-boundary AI without external model training on customer data, and role-based separation so prime and subcontractor personnel access only authorized technical scope while procurement-sensitive government estimates remain restricted to agency personnel (FAR 3.104). Commercial YARDOS and customer-hosted or on-premises installations are excluded from the FedRAMP 20x Class C scope.

serviceProperties.documentationOverview: Planned documentation includes public service scope and secure configuration guidance, plus a Certification Package Overview, Security Decision Record, assessment materials, and ongoing certification reports for authorized parties.

offeringServices.serviceDescription: Unified federal MRO and cost-estimating SaaS platform operated by Oxalis Solutions LLC in dedicated per-tenant AWS GovCloud (US) accounts, encompassing four integrated modules within one Minimum Assessment Scope: (1) Work & Inspection Management (work items, inspection plans, condition found reports, change-order routing, and closeout); (2) Estimation & IGCEs (Independent Government Cost Estimate and growth-work IGE preparation, traceable Bases of Estimate aligned with GAO-20-195G, baseline cost/schedule estimating under FAR 15.404-1 and FAR 36.203, change-order definitization support under DFARS 243.204-70, and agency-only procurement-sensitive separation under FAR 3.104); (3) Specialist AI (agency-controlled AI assistance operating inside AWS GovCloud (US) under tenant role permissions with no external model training on customer data); and (4) Program Oversight & Reporting (real-time scope, schedule, predicted end cost, and role-scoped prime/subcontractor collaboration alongside agency ERP systems).
